company_name: 广东顺威精密塑料股份有限公司
decision_frame: Pre-cutoff underwriting of the consolidated plastic air-conditioner fan-blade business, its cash conversion and expansion commitments using FY2015-FY2017 reports only.
underwriting_route: Anchor on mature fan-blade earnings, condition owner cash on working-capital intensity, and isolate expansion and liquidity risks as scenario or stress routes.

situation_model.summary: The company is a direct-sales, make-to-order supplier that integrates modified plastics, molds and fan-blade design for major HVAC customers. Revenue grew through FY2017, but earnings and cash conversion were volatile while overseas and smart-bathroom projects were being prepared.

industry_future_thesis.most_likely_regime: HVAC demand remains cyclical and concentrated among large OEMs; engineering integration and reliable delivery preserve incumbent programs, while input-cost and customer bargaining pressure keep margins variable.
industry_future_thesis.profit_pool_transmission: Profit pools accrue to suppliers that combine material formulation, tooling and blade qualification with scale delivery; raw-material inflation, OEM concentration and working-capital funding determine how much reaches equity.
industry_future_thesis.company_exposure: Exposure is primarily to domestic and multinational HVAC OEM programs, with additional unproven exposure to Thailand manufacturing and smart-bathroom initiatives.
industry_future_thesis.adaptation: The integrated design-tooling-formulation model and the completed Thailand plant are possible adaptation avenues, but project economics and ramp evidence are not yet established at cutoff.
industry_future_thesis.normal_economics: Core economics can normalize around recurring fan-blade programs, but three-year results show sensitivity to material and labor costs, inventory builds and customer collection timing.
industry_future_thesis.permanent_loss: Permanent loss could arise from sustained OEM insourcing or supplier substitution, failed expansion consuming liquidity, or leverage amplifying a demand downturn.
industry_future_thesis.valuation_treatment: Use a bounded core-earnings route; treat owner cash conditionally on working-capital discipline and keep expansion as scenario-only with a separate financing stress.
industry_future_thesis.strongest_rival: Large HVAC OEMs' in-house production or alternate qualified fan-blade suppliers
reversal_observations: Evidence that major HVAC OEMs shift volume to in-house production or alternate qualified suppliers would reverse the incumbent-volume premise.
Audited evidence of sustained positive cash after maintenance needs and stable inventory turns would upgrade the owner-cash route.
Audited evidence that Thailand or smart-bathroom projects earn returns above their funding cost would promote the growth scenario.

business_position: A qualified incumbent component supplier with integrated plastics, tooling and blade engineering, meaningful OEM concentration, and demonstrated revenue scale but uneven profitability.
survival_case: Survival depends on retaining OEM qualifications, passing through material and labor inflation, converting receivables and inventory without excessive borrowing, and sequencing Thailand and other projects within available liquidity.
adaptation_case: Management can deepen the integrated engineering offering and use the Thailand plant for customer proximity, while project expansion remains conditional until utilization, margins and cash returns are evidenced.
normalization_case: Normalize only the recurring fan-blade platform around a conservative after-tax earnings range informed by FY2015-FY2017; exclude one-off impairments, subsidies, disputes and project start-up costs rather than treating the FY2017 loss as steady state.
permanent_loss_map: Monitor OEM insourcing or requalification losses, unresolved project overruns, inventory obsolescence, and debt-funded working-capital strain as paths to irreversible capital impairment.

value_route.route_reasoning: The core route is the only base operating anchor. Owner cash is conditional because receivables, inventory and total long-lived-asset spending vary materially. Growth and financing routes are separated from base economics, and noncore directions lack standalone evidence.

strongest_rival: Large HVAC OEMs' in-house production or alternate qualified fan-blade suppliers
reversal_observations: Evidence that major HVAC OEMs shift volume to in-house production or alternate qualified suppliers would reverse the incumbent-volume premise.
Audited evidence of sustained positive cash after maintenance needs and stable inventory turns would upgrade the owner-cash route.
Audited evidence that Thailand or smart-bathroom projects earn returns above their funding cost would promote the growth scenario.

component_treatments.reason: Recurring fan-blade, modified-plastic and tooling activities are the disclosed operating core with three years of consolidated revenue and profit data.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Provides the bounded base earnings anchor, subject to OEM concentration and cost volatility.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote confidence if subsequent reports show retained programs, stable margins and repeat cash conversion.

component_treatments.reason: Receivables and inventory rose materially through FY2017 and inventory was built ahead of a seasonal peak, making owner cash dependent on turns and collection.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Owner cash is conditional and financing pressure increases when working capital absorbs operating cash.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote to base owner cash only after audited evidence of normalized receivable days, inventory turns and cash conversion.

component_treatments.reason: Thailand manufacturing, smart-bathroom and other new directions were in construction or preparation without standalone revenue, profit or return evidence at cutoff.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Expansion may require cash and generate either upside or additional losses; it is not included in base earnings or owner cash.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Promote only with audited segment economics, utilization, invested capital and cash-return evidence.

component_treatments.reason: Short-term borrowings increased to RMB350.5m in FY2017, with RMB50m of long-term debt reclassified as current, while operating cash was only RMB7.2m.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: Liquidity and refinancing are a distinct stress route that can amplify a cyclical downturn.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Resolve stress if maturities, covenants and debt service are covered by recurring operating cash without repeated borrowing.

component_treatments.reason: Automotive, energy, smart-home and other cited directions have no separately comparable revenue, profit or cash-flow disclosure in the source package.
component_treatments.investment_consequence: No base earnings, owner-cash or primary value contribution is assigned; any realization is optional upside only.
component_treatments.promotion_or_resolution_condition: Require audited standalone segment disclosure and demonstrated cash contribution before inclusion.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Retained OEM programs and stable gross margin through a cycle.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Sustained volume loss from OEM insourcing or alternate suppliers.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Working-capital days normalize with positive cash conversion.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Receivable or inventory growth repeatedly consumes operating cash.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Audited project returns and utilization exceed funding cost.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Projects require recurring funding without identifiable contribution.

component_decisions.promotion_test: Debt maturities are serviced from recurring operating cash.
component_decisions.invalidation_test: Refinancing depends on continued borrowing despite weak operating cash.
No separable disclosure or cash contribution.

evidence_trace.scope: Products, integrated chain, direct sales and make-to-order production
Revenue, net income, adjusted net income and operating cash flow
Receivables, inventory, payables and seasonal inventory build
Short-term borrowings and current reclassification of long-term debt
Thailand plant, smart-bathroom project, offerings and capital projects
Automotive, energy and smart-home directions lack standalone financials

evidence_trace.locator: FY2015-FY2017 customer concentration and profit volatility

sensitivity_magnitude_observation.responsibility_boundary: Customer concentration affects recurring core volume and pricing; management response and macro demand are outside this bound.

underwriting_thesis.central_path: A qualified HVAC component incumbent can sustain a modest normalized core, but owner cash and financing remain conditional because working capital and expansion commitments compete for liquidity.
underwriting_thesis.normal_earnings_treatment: Use a conservative bounded after-tax core range; FY2017 exceptional costs and project charges are not recurring, while material and labor inflation remain live deductions.
underwriting_thesis.owner_cash_treatment: Treat owner cash as conditional and avoid a point estimate because maintenance versus growth spending and working-capital normalization are not fully separable.
underwriting_thesis.permanent_loss_treatment: Stress OEM displacement, project failure and refinancing dependence; these are monitored as separate permanent-loss paths.
underwriting_thesis.value_route_treatment: Primary route is core normalized earnings with a conditional owner-cash corroboration; growth is scenario-only and debt is stress-only.
underwriting_thesis.strongest_rival: Large HVAC OEMs' in-house production or alternate qualified fan-blade suppliers
underwriting_thesis.monitoring: Track OEM concentration and program retention, material/labor costs, receivable and inventory turns, operating cash after total long-lived-asset spending, debt maturities, and audited Thailand project returns.

investment_treatment: Price-free underwriting record: continue only with explicit monitoring of core program retention, cash conversion and financing; no valuation, return or action conclusion is issued at the sealed cutoff.

basis.operating_perimeter: Consolidated recurring fan-blade, modified-plastic and tooling operations

rows.economic_reason: FY2015-FY2017 adjusted earnings span a loss, RMB27.5m profit and a project/impairment-affected loss; a conservative recurring core range is therefore bounded rather than point-estimated.

quantification.reason: No standalone project revenue, margin or return evidence at cutoff.
quantification.conservative_treatment: Keep outside base range and test only as scenario.

rows.economic_reason: Thailand and smart-bathroom initiatives may add or consume earnings, but their contribution is unresolved.

quantification.reason: Automotive, energy and smart-home directions lack comparable standalone data.

rows.economic_reason: No evidence supports an earnings contribution or deduction from these optional directions.

normal_earnings.basis: Higher concentration raises dependence on OEM volume and pricing; the bounded effect is directional around the recurring core.

magnitude_evidence.responsibility_boundary: Customer concentration affects recurring core volume and pricing; management response and macro demand are outside this bound.

calculation_binding.expression: bounded concentration sensitivity assessed against recurring core earnings

owner_cash.basis: Collection timing and capex split are not quantified by customer.

delta.reason: Source package does not provide customer-level margins, credit terms or cash conversion.
delta.conservative_treatment: Keep owner-cash effect conditional and do not assign a numeric delta.

transmission.responsibility_boundary: Concentration sensitivity covers disclosed customer mix and recurring core economics; project execution, macro demand and financing availability are outside this sensitivity.
